value: A landlord cannot ask for a deposit of more than one month's rent; the agreed amount should be documented and both parties get a signed and dated receipt.

From 1 March 2026 a national system applies to all private tenancies: rent can be increased once per year by 2 percent or the rate of inflation (CPI), whichever is lower. Re-setting to market rent is not allowed during a tenancy that began before 1 March 2026.
The 2 percent cap does not apply to newly built apartments and student-specific accommodation that commenced from 10 June 2025; there rent can rise by CPI inflation even if higher than 2 percent.
A landlord must serve a rent review notice on the tenant at least 90 days before the new rent takes effect and serve a copy on the RTB within 7 days.
